time: fix alt timer cancellation and insertion race

sync: use acquire/release orderings in `Notify`. Every atomic operation on `Notify::state` used `SeqCst`. Nothing needs the global total order: every lock-avoidance decision is made by an RMW, which always reads the latest value in that atomic's modification order, and every stale load is

io: read lines as bytes so a partial line survives an I/O error. `Lines` accumulated into a `String`, so a partial line interrupted by an I/O error could not be kept when it ended mid multi-byte character. The next poll then tripped `debug_assert!(output.is_empty())`, or underflowed `vector.len()
runtime: fix misleading signal driver panic message

runtime: fix idle bookkeeping when a task dump wakes parked workers. Requesting a task dump calls `notify_all`, which unparks every worker thread directly rather than going through `Idle`. A worker that was parked at that point is woken to be traced while the scheduler still counts it as a sleeper.
fs: fix coop for emscripten fs shim
rt: suggest `.await` in nested `block_on` panic. Point callers at `.await` when `block_on` is invoked from an async context, and assert the hint in the nesting test.

rt: skip non-idle tasks during taskdumps. Task dumps currently assume that if no worker threads are running tasks, then all tasks are idle. However, when `block_in_place` is used, this assumption is false. This leads to a panic inside the scheduler.

sync: notify `CancellationToken` descendants after releasing locks. Currently, `tree_node::cancel` calls `notify_waiters()` on cancelled children and grandchildren while still holding the mutexes of their parent and grandparent nodes. If a descendant's waker synchronously operates on an ancestor
net: fix peer credentials on NetBSD
caddyfile: fix importGraph self-loop and stale-edge bugs

fix: require module path boundaries when matching packages

caddyhttp: only replace known placeholders in respond headers. The respond directive expanded header field names and values with repl.ReplaceAll, which blanks any {...} the replacer does not recognize
reverseproxy: propagate TCP half-close on upgraded streams
reverseproxy: Move websocket header normalization later
reverseproxy: Fix partial response not flushed to clients
caddyhttp: fix randString sameCase dictionary to match its docs

requestbody: replace only known placeholders in the set body. The set body is user-supplied and commonly JSON, but it was expanded with ReplaceAll, which blanks any {...} the replacer does not recognize, so a plain JSON body was sent empty and a body mixing JSON with a real placeholder was mangled
internal: fix `MaxSizeSubjectsListForLog` off-by-one when `maxToDisplay` is `0`

caddyauth: only replace known placeholders in basic auth credentials. The basic auth provider expanded account usernames and passwords with repl.ReplaceAll, which blanks any {...} the replacer does not recognize

timeouts: fix idle writer terminate h2 response writers between writes

fix: preserve FastCGI dial errors for retry. Wrap backend dial failures as reverseproxy.DialError so non-GET requests can be retried when no connection was made.

httpcaddyfile: keep source order for vars with non-comparable matchers. Use i/j swap instead of !sortByPath for vars, so matchers that can't be compared keep their Caddyfile order. Path matchers still sort with the more specific one later. Fixes the vars ordering part of #8187.
